sentences.en: Cantonese is the prestige dialect of the Yue group.
sentences.zh: 粤语是 Yue 组的 prestige 方言。

sentences.en: My dream is to study Cantonese in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是在香港学习广东话。

sentences.en: Mandarin only has four tones, while Cantonese has six to nine.
sentences.zh: 普通话只有四个声调，而广东话有六到九个。
